title: (RMMZ) Request for VisuStella-compatible animated side view battlers based on RMXP monsters!

posts.author: Johnbell9001
posts.body:
Hi there!!
I'm new, but not. Since 2009 I've been dabbling with RPG Maker, I started out with XP, and was working on a cringe-worthy personal project on and off over the years. Fast forward to now, I use a Mac, and since RMXP is windows only, I purchased MZ when it came out in 2020, and converted a lot of my assets to work with that. And now, I find myself actively working on this little project of mine (still cringe-worthy but I digress)
I recently implemented the VisuStella battle system into my game, and have found luck with some animated side view battlers. Mainly thanks to this site, specifically "what the mz rtp is missing" thread. However, there are a few monsters from RMXP in my original project that I use in my current one, and
I am requesting to see if anyone would be able to make these RMXP creatures into MZ-style VisuStella animated side-view battlers.
These are some of the monsters I am requesting,
both from the original RMXP RTP
:
1. Monster 13 (large red dragon)
2. Angel 1 (small angel holding a war horn)
Since these are from RMXP, I'm not going to post the source material, though screenshots are below. I was able to google it using the original filenames, but if you also own XP, please PM me and I can share the exact images.
This would help me so much with my little passion project. While I don't know if I'm ever going to share it publicly when I eventually finish it (I don't have a team, have lots of resources accumulated over the years that I would want to properly credit, plus it's cringe), I would really like to use the original monsters that I had implemented so long ago, in my present game. Please feel free to ask for any additional details that I could provide. Thanks for your consideration!
(Screenshots below are a little bit of reference from my game. The dragon is Monster 13 from RMXP. Angel is Angel 1 from XP. Player character was made by me, and yes it is based on Arshes. Lol. I made the face for my character, but the faces for the RMXP monsters, I couldn't even tell you where they came from. Definitely not mine.
)
